_doc: Per-endpoint, per-IP rate limits in requests per MINUTE, read once at API
startup (override the location with RATE_LIMITS_FILE). Keys under
'endpoints' are FastAPI route templates exactly as declared, e.g.
/api/claims/{post_id}/live — never concrete paths. Any endpoint not
listed gets default_per_minute. A value <= 0 disables the per-endpoint
cap for that route (the general all-endpoints cap still applies).
Changes take effect on restart; no code change or rebuild needed.
